basic_profile.bio: An avid tech enthusiast and gamer living in Cincinnati, Ohio. Passionate about all things tech, especially gaming peripherals and software. I spend my evenings exploring new tech trends and gaming strategies. Currently working as a software developer, which keeps me busy during the weekdays. In a long-term relationship with my college sweetheart. I usually browse Reddit late at night and on weekends when I have more free time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science from Miami University, I have a solid foundation in programming and software development. My expertise lies in developing user-centric applications, and I'm always keen to explore advancements in gaming technology. Over the years, I've taught myself about hardware customization, particularly in gaming peripherals.
